# Step - drop_index

`drop_index` · category: [Property indexes](../../traversal/step_reference.md#property-indexes)

Drops a property index; false when there is none.

## Forms

```text
drop_index(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
{ g.create_index(#{label: "person", key: "age"}); g.drop_index("person_age") }   // true
```
